d: In this video, Firstpost explains why an Italian chef in Australia was fired for refusing to put pineapple on pizza. Chef Tamburella, who worked at a restaurant in Brisbane, reportedly refused to serve the controversial topping for the third time in four years, calling it an 'insult to his culture'. His stand has since won him support online, with social media users hailing him as a hero and defender of Italian cuisine. What makes pineapple on pizza such a contentious issue? Gursshheenkaur Gahllen brings you all the details on Vantage on Firstpost.
